citations.quote: On 12 August I received a written notice of termination from Verwaltung Emme & Söhne for our 5.5-room flat at Allmendstrasse 61 in Kriens, with effect from 31 July 2027.
We have three children at the local school, the youngest has special needs and depends on the support teacher there.
The notice refers to the CHF 6570 we owe, three months that we were unable to pay after my business closed.
What strikes me is the timing: only last month I was the one who collected signatures from all the tenants about the dangerous balcony railings and sent them to the management and the town.
We will definitely need an extension if the termination is upheld.

plan.because: Needed to verify the parties, property and tenancy terms.
The reported notice is not the original; its form, addressee, end date and grounds need review.
Urgently establish the recipient and evidenced delivery date for the deadline assessment.
Needed to assess the agreed notice period and relevant dates.
Obtain the landlord's stated ground and its factual basis; the customer report does not replace the original.
Family-home status and whether separate spouse or registered-partner service is relevant remain unresolved.
Arrears are reported; the cure period, claimed arrears and termination warning need verification.
Needed to verify amounts due, payment dates and the outstanding balance.
The reported balcony-safety complaint and timing make the chronology relevant to the retaliation screen.
An extension is sought; dated searches, responses and hardship evidence are relevant.

questions: In which year was the notice received on 12 August, and what delivery or collection evidence is available? Please provide it urgently so the challenge deadline can be assessed.
Is the flat a shared home with a spouse or registered partner? If so, did that person receive a separate notice?
Is there an existing dated housing-search record, including responses and the family's difficulties finding suitable accommodation?
